fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects suspicious way to dump the kernel on Windows systems using dtrace.exe, which is available on Windows systems since Windows 10 19H1
fields.name: Suspicious Kernel Dump Using Dtrace
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\dtrace.exe" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "lkd(0)") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "syscall:::return" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "lkd(")))
